sections.appearance: Rio is a tall girl that appears to have a height and build older for her age (because of the treatment she received on Seminar) with long black hair that reaches her thigh with blunt bangs. She has a fair skin complexion and red eyes with white pupils. Halo ==== Rio has a metallic halo with two red curved lines opposite of each other within. Uniform ==== Her uniform consists of a three-buttoned black blazer and a white long-sleeved turtleneck sweater as well as a black knife-pleated mini skirt with a black opaque pantyhose. She also wears black stiletto heels, a holster with two belts tightly attached to her right thigh. On her left chest is a Millennium ID card. Additionally, she wears an Millennium logo hairpin and a square watch on her left wrist. In winter version: She was wearing a knee-length black coat, neatly buttoned, Black belt with gold buckle. Underneath, she was wearing a white turtleneck sweater. Below, she wore black tights and boots, she was wearing black gloves. Firearm ==== She uses a black Springfield Armory M1911 Mil-Spec pistol with gray grips. The Millennium insignia is etched on the forward slide.

sections.personality: Rio is a cold person that has always been unsociable and rather scrupulous. She never lets emotions change her mind and always sticks to the facts. Her determination to identify and analyze potential threats to Millennium and Kivotos at large has led her to develop an extensive surveillance system as a result. This in turn has caused her to gain a terrifying reputation among Millennium's student body, which she personally ignores.
